Details zum Jobangebot
The Position

In an enterprise world filled with poor design, we’re looking to you to help save our Fortune 500 clients! Our Senior UX Architects provide user experience leadership and Pega-specific user interface design guidance on multiple implementation projects. Project leadership activities include creating and executing a UX project plan, and working closely with client/partner delivery teams to create and develop appropriate UX deliverables.

Location: Munich Area/ Frankfurt Area/ Stuttgart Area/ Düsseldorf Area/ Hamburg Area

In This Role, You Will

Apply modern and cutting edge user interface design principals
Develop implementation design and prototypes for Pega UI projects in a customer project context
Develop comprehensive UI wireframes with Pega tools
Implement branding requirements through the application and manipulation of Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

Pega Offers
The Person
Success in this position requires a firm understanding of user-centered design process, modern interaction design principles and a complementary blend of design expertise and hands on UI development skill.
Qualifications Will Include
Travel Requirements
50 – 75% - travel to and work on client/other sites.
We value diversity in our workforce and welcome enquiries from all suitably qualified applicants.
